public_relationship: A lone survival player and his tamed companion share an ordinary homestead routine.
private_tension: The protagonist initially treats the wolf as one secure part of the structure he controls, while its obedience makes it unable to escape the later pen alone.
shared_history: He tamed the wolf, built its pen beside the house and routinely seats it before mining.
what_a_wants_from_b: At first he wants the wolf safely contained within his authored home; under pressure he wants it to trust and follow him beyond that home.
what_b_wants_from_a: Expressed behaviourally, the wolf wants proximity, clear release and a traversable route.
power_balance: The protagonist controls seating, gate access and route choice; the fire reverses this by making the wolf’s vulnerability control his final allocation of time.
secret: The empty future pen conceals that the older protagonist has already rescued the wolf and kept it below the ridge sight line.
predicted_change: Possession within a protected structure becomes chosen responsibility after the structure is lost.
